title: The Asset of Marseille's old port Anew
author: Wren Reyes
blurb: Zephyrine Nakamura, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
